data.title: 初雪 · 给家人的围巾
data.description: 她把两条围巾并排放在手臂上，先看颜色，又捏了捏布料。挑好后，她请店员多留一点包装纸，打算自己写一张卡片。
data.action: 比较两条不同颜色的围巾
data.camera: 中景，围巾色彩位于画面前景
data.promptProse: In a cozy Kjerag textile boutique draped with hand-woven woolens, Pramanix gently compares two vibrant geometric-patterned scarves against the soft daylight filtering through the shopfront. Bales of raw fleece, wooden spinning wheels, and shelves of natural dyes create an authentic, artisanal craft setting as her snow leopard ears twitch with discerning focus.
